purpose: Systematic en-ja SRS admission sampling matrix for topic preference guardrails: shared proficiency levels for every runtime-safe topic plus adversarial mixed-profile stress cases.

proficiency_grid.purpose: beginner stress level; topic preference must not overpower readiness
upper-beginner level; should surface only approachable topic words
intermediate main-use level; expected to show clear topic movement
N1-ish/post-pedagogical transition; should expose more specialized topic words
advanced-tail level; should separate useful domain words from recondite leftovers
